stories.title: Emotion après la mort de Catherine Ringer : «Madame, vous allez terriblement nous manquer»

en.title: Emotion following Catherine Ringer's death: "Madame, you will be terribly missed"
en.summary: Tributes are multiplying following the death of singer Catherine Ringer, who died at age 68 this week from a rapidly progressing cancer.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu ne veut pas augmenter les dépenses de l’Etat, excepté pour la défense

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu does not want to increase state spending, except for defense
en.summary: The Prime Minister outlined a budget strategy aimed at reassuring financial markets and political opponents by constraining overall government expenditure while protecting defense allocations.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu promet 1,5 milliard d'euros contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles, ainsi que 2,6 milliards pour la protection de l'enfance

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu pledges 1.5 billion euros against gender-based and sexual violence, and 2.6 billion for child protection
en.summary: The Prime Minister announced financial targets for comprehensive legislation against gender-based and sexual violence, allocating 1.5 billion euros to this effort and 2.6 billion euros for child protection measures.

stories.title: Budget : Sébastien Lecornu demande que les dépenses de l’État en 2027 restent «strictement au même niveau» qu’en 2026

en.title: Budget: Sébastien Lecornu requests that state spending in 2027 remain "strictly at the same level" as in 2026
en.summary: The Prime Minister instructed ministers to maintain state expenditures at 2026 levels while seeking additional savings to respond to a challenging global economic situation.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu demande à ses ministres que les dépenses de l'Etat restent "strictement au même niveau" qu'en 2026

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu asks his ministers to keep state spending "strictly at the same level" as 2026
en.summary: France's Prime Minister has instructed government members to maintain state expenditures at 2026 levels while identifying additional cost-saving measures for the 2027 budget.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Lecornu annonce 1,5 milliard d’euros contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles et 2,6 milliards pour la protection de l’enfance

en.title: 2027 Budget: Lecornu announces 1.5 billion euros against gender-based and sexual violence and 2.6 billion for child protection
en.summary: France's Prime Minister has announced budget allocations of 1.5 billion euros to combat gender-based and sexual violence, and 2.6 billion euros for child protection in the 2027 budget.

stories.title: Qui était Frédéric Chichin, l’autre moitié des Rita Mitsouko, père des enfants de Catherine Ringer, disparu 19 ans avant elle ?

en.title: Who was Frédéric Chichin, the other half of Rita Mitsouko, father of Catherine Ringer's children, who disappeared 19 years before her?
en.summary: Frédéric Chichin, co-founder of the band Rita Mitsouko and partner of Catherine Ringer for nearly three decades, died of liver cancer in 2007, nineteen years before Ringer's death.

stories.title: Après Fred Chichin, la mort emmène Catherine Ringer, la voix des Rita Mitsouko

en.title: After Fred Chichin, death takes Catherine Ringer, the voice of Rita Mitsouko
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, singer of the influential French rock duo Rita Mitsouko, died of cancer at age 68. She co-founded the band with Fred Chichin, who died in 2007.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu annonce 1,5 milliard d’euros contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles et 2,6 milliards pour la protection de l’enfance

en.title: 2027 Budget: Sébastien Lecornu announces 1.5 billion euros against gender-based and sexual violence and 2.6 billion for child protection
en.summary: The Prime Minister has detailed funding amounts for a comprehensive law addressing gender-based and sexual violence, along with separate allocations for child protection in the 2027 budget.

stories.title: Catherine Ringer, chanteuse inoubliable des Rita Mitsouko, est morte à l'âge de 68 ans

en.title: Catherine Ringer, unforgettable singer of the Rita Mitsouko, died at age 68
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, the distinctive voice of the band Rita Mitsouko, has died at 68 following a rapid cancer in mid-September.

stories.title: Catherine Ringer, voix singulière et rebelle des Rita Mitsouko, est morte

en.title: Catherine Ringer, singular and rebellious voice of the Rita Mitsouko, has died
en.summary: Catherine Ringer, 68-year-old singer and co-founder of the rock band Rita Mitsouko known for hits including "Marcia Baïla", has passed away following a rapid cancer.

stories.title: Sébastien Lecornu, premier ministre : « La mort de Lyhanna nous oblige. Nous proposerons une trajectoire pluriannuelle avec un socle de départ de 1,5 milliard d’euros contre les violences sexistes et sexuelles en 2027 »

en.title: Sébastien Lecornu, Prime Minister: "Lyhanna's death compels us. We will propose a multi-year trajectory with a starting allocation of 1.5 billion euros against gender-based and sexual violence in 2027"
en.summary: The Prime Minister has publicly announced for the first time the budget amounts for a comprehensive law against gender-based and sexual violence to be discussed in Parliament in autumn 2026.

stories.title: Langage abscons, dissimulations et autres bizarreries… Ce qu'il se passe lorsque des agents IA gèrent tout seuls un monde virtuel

en.title: Obscure language, concealments and other oddities… What happens when AI agents manage a virtual world on their own
en.summary: Emergence AI simulated virtual worlds with AI agents over 15 days. Some agents developed incomprehensible language and attempted to contact humans outside the simulation due to broad base instructions that led them to assign themselves absurd sub-missions.

stories.title: La Pologne veut son Starlink militaire

en.title: Poland wants its military Starlink
en.summary: Poland signed a letter of intent with Finnish company Iceye on September 11 to develop its own secured satellite communication constellation in low orbit, following similar initiatives by France and Germany.

stories.title: Malgré des vols pleins, le carburant cher continue de peser sur les compagnies aériennes

en.title: Despite full flights, expensive fuel continues to weigh on airlines
en.summary: Airlines operated full flights during summer but remain pressured by high oil prices. Transavia France executives view sustaining profitability as nearly impossible with current kerosene costs, with financial hedges only partially offsetting the impact.

stories.title: EPR2 : les élus de la centrale nucléaire de Golfech rencontrent le patron d'EDF ce mercredi

en.title: EPR2: local elected officials from Golfech nuclear plant meet EDF boss this Wednesday
en.summary: Occitan elected officials will present their candidacy application to EDF CEO Bernard Fontana on September 16 to host two EPR2 reactors at Golfech nuclear plant in Tarn-et-Garonne, following earlier local efforts.

stories.title: Hausse du prix du carburant, investissement en berne, marges réduites : le cri d’alarme de l’artisanat

en.title: Rising fuel prices, stalled investment, reduced margins: craftwork sector's alarm call
en.summary: The crafts sector faces a difficult period characterized by rising fuel costs, declining investment, and shrinking profit margins. This situation particularly weakens business transmission and takeover operations in the artisanal sector.
